## + with INTERVAL operands
# Sources: BigQuery's operators reference (interval arithmetic operators); GoogleSQL's
# compliance/functions_testlib_interval.cc (interval, datetime and timestamp additions, NULLs and
# overflow).

SELECT CAST(DATE '2021-04-20' + INTERVAL 25 HOUR AS STRING)
=> "2021-04-21 01:00:00"

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL 25 HOUR + DATE '2021-04-20' AS STRING)
=> "2021-04-21 01:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-01-31 00:00:00' + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS STRING)
=> "2000-02-29 00:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-02-29 00:00:00' + INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS STRING)
=> "2001-02-28 00:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6' YEAR TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "2001-03-04 04:05:06"

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL '-1-2 -3 -4:5:6' YEAR TO SECOND + DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' AS STRING)
=> "1998-10-28 19:54:54"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '1 -2 3:4:5' MONTH TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "2000-01-30 03:04:05"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '-0:0:0.000001' HOUR TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "1999-12-31 23:59:59.999999"

SELECT DATETIME '9999-12-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT DATETIME '0001-12-31 00:00:00' + INTERVAL -1 YEAR
=> error:

SELECT DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' + CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null

SELECT CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) + INTERVAL 100 YEAR
=> null

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP '2000-02-28 00:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS STRING)
=> "2000-02-29 00:00:00+00"

SELECT CAST(INTERVAL '-25:0:0' HOUR TO SECOND + TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' AS STRING)
=> "1999-12-30 23:00:00+00"

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL '1:2:3.456' HOUR TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "2000-01-01 01:02:03.456+00"

# GoogleSQL adds no months or years to a TIMESTAMP.
SELECT TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL 1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' + INTERVAL -1 YEAR
=> error:

SELECT CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL -1 SECOND
=> null

SELECT INTERVAL 1 YEAR + INTERVAL 2 MONTH
=> "1-2 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6' YEAR TO SECOND + INTERVAL '1-1 1 1:1:1' YEAR TO SECOND
=> "2-3 4 5:6:7"

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(1, -2, 3, -4, 5, -6) + MAKE_INTERVAL(-1, 2, -3, 4, -5, 6)
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL 10000 YEAR + INTERVAL 3660000 DAY
=> "10000-0 3660000 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL -10000 YEAR + INTERVAL -1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL 3660000 DAY + INTERVAL 1 DAY
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL 1 YEAR + CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null
